answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using Verifiable Delay Functions. A lotus protocol emits a continuous river of sequential cryptographic puzzles that identities must solve to remain valid. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating uninterrupted single-core compute time to every fake identity. Nodes missing deadlines fall into a sable inactive state. However, this continuous computation wastes energy and favors adversaries equipped with high-speed custom ASICs.
